newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Securities to buy NASD broker.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Securities to buy NASD broker.

text.p: Southwest Securities Group Inc said Friday it had reached agreement in principle to acquire Equity Securities Trading Company Inc, an Minneapolis-based NASD broker/dealer firm.

The details of the transaction, which will be accomplished through an exchange of stock, were not disclosed. The transaction is subject to due diligence and regulatory approval by all necessary regulatory bodies, including the National Association of Securities Dealers and the New York Stock Exchange.
Southwest Securities is a holding company that provides fully disclosed securities clearing and related services as well as securities brokerage, investment banking and asset management services.
Equity Securities has more than $100 million in assets and operates a regional securites clearing business.
